name: caraka
description: Send the task. Caraka runs it. — a thin bridge from Telegram to the coding agent already installed on your machine.
author: Rama Aditya <halo@caraka.dev> (https://caraka.dev)

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: oxlint src test scripts assets/web && oxfmt --check src test scripts bin assets/web package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/unit.test.ts && npm run web
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-claude.mjs && node scripts/smoke-cli.mjs claude-code cli && node scripts/smoke-cli.mjs codex && node scripts/smoke-cli.mjs aider && node scripts/smoke-cli.mjs goose
scripts.verify: npm run scan:secrets && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run e2e && npm run web:browser && npm --prefix site run test
